owner_calls.question: Stage 1 (Ms. Marvel#3) only tells Sana's vision of the train and her call to Kamala; nothing happens between Aamir and Sana there (Sana is in Karachi, not at the wedding). Drop the stage, or keep it?
options: Drop stage 1 (stage 0 stands for the whole series)
owner_calls.evidence: Ms. Marvel#3 (Destined): after the wedding attack, Sana calls Kamala to say she saw the train too and urges Kamala and Muneeba to come to Karachi. Aamir is not part of it.
